rows.evidence_ceiling: local private artifact package only, not public independent reproduction
rows.future_evidence_required: Explicit publication approval, public archive deposition, independent or blinded reproduction, and external reviewer execution before any public-release or independent-reproduction claim.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read local hashes, manifests, or validation commands as a public archive release, independent reproduction, empirical validation, or publication.

rows.evidence_ceiling: deterministic parameter sweep, not empirical practice evidence
rows.future_evidence_required: Pre-registered empirical or agent-benchmark evidence linking reduced complexity to task performance and subjective reports.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read pruning in the sweep as evidence that meditation or realization removes self-models in people.

rows.future_evidence_required: Independent human-subject measures and normative review before any compassion or wellbeing claim.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read broadened model scope as moral virtue, compassion, clinical improvement, or contemplative attainment.

rows.future_evidence_required: Neural data provenance, preprocessing records, null models, and negative controls before any neural-criticality claim.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read the simulated ensemble as a measured neural criticality regime or a biomarker of realization.

rows.future_evidence_required: Validated operational measures and task data if metacognitive access is tied to people or empirical agents.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read the sweep parameter as a measured metacognitive trait or training outcome.

rows.future_evidence_required: Human review, ethics constraints, safety language, and outcome-independent usability validation before user-facing deployment.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read protocol mappings as instructions, therapy, or evidence that a practice induces realization.

rows.evidence_ceiling: package import, agent construction, state inference, and policy-posterior normalization diagnostics
rows.future_evidence_required: Version-pinned benchmark suites and comparison agents if performance or optimality claims are introduced.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read the runtime dependency check as a benchmark of active-inference optimality or scientific validity.

rows.evidence_ceiling: finite equation registry plus two-qubit quantum-information witnesses, mixed-state entanglement checks, measurement-cover/local-polytope controls, channel-cost accounting, dephasing controls, stochastic quantum-trajectory checks, and implemented extension-engine audits
rows.future_evidence_required: A separately reviewed physical qFEP implementation, independent quantum-information replication, or ethics-reviewed human/practice dataset depending on the stronger claim.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read finite entropy, mixed-state entanglement, CHSH, measurement-cover/local-polytope, channel-cost, dephasing, Lindblad, many-body, sheaf, QRF-covariance, or provenance controls as physical qFEP realization, empirical practice evidence, or neural measurement.

rows.evidence_ceiling: CHSH witness over a finite two-qubit family
rows.future_evidence_required: General sheaf-obstruction checks, noncontextual polytope comparisons, and explicit QRF transformation tests.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read the CHSH witness as a general contextuality proof for all QRF deployments or as empirical evidence.

rows.evidence_ceiling: finite CHSH measurement-cover probability table plus local-polytope LP audit
rows.future_evidence_required: A general measurement-scenario engine with compatibility hypergraphs, obstruction or noncontextual-polytope witnesses, and QRF transformation tests.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read the CHSH table or local-polytope infeasibility as a full sheaf obstruction proof, a many-body QRF transformation, a qFEP dynamics simulation, or empirical evidence.

rows.future_evidence_required: Boundary-Hamiltonian-linked Lindblad or collision-model dynamics, many-body subsystem cuts, and explicit QRF transformations.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read the dephasing channel as the paper's full qFEP dynamics, a many-body observer boundary, or empirical quantum evidence.

rows.future_evidence_required: Higher-dimensional, multipartite, externally reviewed many-body, and physical open-system extensions with independent benchmarks and negative controls.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read this finite witness as a simulation of a universe-agent boundary or mixed open-system qFEP dynamics.

rows.future_evidence_required: A separate empirical or formal target with its own source ledger if self-evidencing is tested directly.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read background self-evidencing scholarship as a new empirical result produced by this repository.

rows.future_evidence_required: Task-linked data or formal proof showing when the modeled separation prior corresponds to an empirical or physical boundary.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read this as evidence that human subject-object boundaries have been reduced.

rows.future_evidence_required: A full qFEP quantum-information implementation or empirical operationalization with source identity and negative controls.
rows.prohibited_inference: Do not read this as proof that real agents lack selves or that a quantum boundary was simulated.

stressors.description: Requires empirical data before empirical claims are permitted.
Prevents toy criticality proxies from becoming neural-measurement claims.
Prevents model-scope quantities from becoming moral or compassion claims.
Prevents protocol mappings from becoming practice efficacy claims.
Prevents finite surrogates from becoming direct quantum-dynamics simulations.
Requires pinned runtime diagnostics before software claims are trusted.
Keeps background or terminology sources from supporting stronger claims.
Keeps finite toy calculations inside their operational-surrogate scope.
